name: Substitution Response 2
definition: Provides details about the collateral substitution response.

ResponseType.name: Response Type
ResponseType.definition: Indicates if the substitution request was accepted or rejected.

CollateralSubstitutionAcceptanceDetails.name: Collateral Substitution Acceptance Details
CollateralSubstitutionAcceptanceDetails.definition: Provides details about the accepted collateral substitution.

CollateralSubstitutionRejectionDetails.name: Collateral Substitution Rejection Details
CollateralSubstitutionRejectionDetails.definition: Provides details about the rejected collateral substitution.

CollateralSubstitutionAcceptancePresence.definition: If Response Type equals Accepted then CollateralSubstitutionAcceptanceDetails must be present and CollateralSubstitutionRejectionDetails must be absent.

CollateralSubstitutionRejectionPresenceR.definition: If Response Type equals Rejected then CollateralSubstitutionRejectionDetails must be present and CollateralSubstitutionAcceptanceDetails must be absent.
